title: Runtime + Console weekly — Thursday checklist (Maya prep)
body:
Purpose: quick sync across runtime, infra, and console teams to unblock canary rollout and track follow-ups. This is a personal prep note — rough, intentionally terse.

Attendees (expected): Diego (runtime), Lina (infra), Samir (console), me (Maya), optional: Priya (SRE)
Duration: 30m (standup format)

Top-of-mind goals for this week:
- Confirm canary policy for mcore-quant version and fallback path to mcore-2.0 (target: 10% traffic by Mon)
- Reduce p95 generation latency to <= 220ms at 4 tokens/sec baseline for the chat route
- Keep Console rollout low-friction: no new UI breaking changes for telemetry widgets during canary

Quick data to surface (prep notes for me):
- p95 token service (chat-route) last 24h: 240ms (inc spike around 03:10 UTC) — check spike cause in infra logs
- Error budget: dedicated pool currently at 96.5% availability month-to-date — fine but trending down after yesterday's kernel upgrade
- Token-cost: avg cost/token up 6% after switching to quantized kernels in test cluster (investigate batching config)

Agenda (rough timed bullets):
1) 0-5m: Quick wins / wins last week (who shipped what)
   - Runtime: Diego — first-pass memory compaction landed on dev (PR #781)
   - Infra: Lina — kernel update rolled to staging; noted throttling on node pool 3
   - Console: Samir — new telemetry card merged behind flag
2) 5-12m: Canary rollout status + blockers (action-first)
   - Current rollout: mcore-quant at 3% traffic; test cohort shows 1.2x latency for long-context traces
   - Blocker: KV cache eviction behavior on quant builds — Diego to share flamegraphs after meeting
3) 12-18m: Observability & alerts review (any noisy alerts to mute?)
   - Proposal: mute low-priority kernel-throttle alerts for node pool 3 until infra scaling fix; Lina + SRE decision
4) 18-25m: Console UX for telemetry during canary (avoid misleading metrics)
   - Samir: add metric annotation for canary cohorts so product sees percent of canary traffic in dashboard
5) 25-30m: Quick round of action items and owners

Open questions / things I want to ask in meeting (notes-to-self):
- Lina: what was the exact cause of the 03:10 UTC p95 spike? autoscaler jitter or network blip? follow-up ticket?
- Diego: can we try disabling auto-prefix-batching for quant variant to see if that restores baseline latency? cheap experiment
- Samir: can you put the 'canary cohort' label on the telemetry card and hide ratio charts until 10% traffic? avoids early misinterpretation

Action items (live list — concise):
- ACTION: Diego Alvarez — upload flamegraphs and sample traces for KV eviction (due: 2025-10-23)
- ACTION: Lina Park — open infra ticket to investigate node-pool-3 autoscaler jitter and propose temp scaling policy (ticket: JIRA-INSIGHT-432) (due: 2025-10-24)
- ACTION: Samir Rao — add canary-cohort annotation to telemetry dashboard + hide ratio charts until >10% traffic (due: 2025-10-24)
- ACTION: Maya Chen (me) — run quick replication with auto-prefix-batching disabled on quant testbed and post results to #runtime-experiments (due: 2025-10-23)
- ACTION: Priya (SRE) — advise on muting kernel-throttle alert for node-pool-3 (decision: mute if infra ticket created) (due: 2025-10-24)

Parking lot (not for this sync, but to track):
- Follow-up: cost analysis of quant kernels vs non-quant for different batch sizes (queue for Optimize team collaboration)
- Design note: long-term, consider per-customer routing policy that prefers non-quant models for low-latency premium customers

Notes after meeting (placeholder — to fill post-sync):
- Consensus: proceed to 10% canary on Mon if flamegraphs show no widespread KV thrash; otherwise pause and iterate
- Lina to propose temp autoscale policy; Samir to ship telemetry annotation behind flag today
- My immediate next step: run the rep test and post traces to the thread (ticket in linked_artifacts)

Quick links / references (copied into prep):
- Canary runbook: https://rwd.confluence/canary-runbook
- Runtime mem compaction PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/781
- Infra alert playbook: https://rwd.confluence/alerts/infra

Tone / reminders: keep this tight, action-oriented. This doc is a scratchpad — will prune before saving final notes to shared Confluence.

-- maya
summary: Personal prep note for Thursday runtime/infra/console weekly: agenda, quick metrics to surface, explicit action items and owners, open questions and parking lot items. Draft status — intended to be converted to shared notes after sync.
